_about: The free-placed level objects, shared by the game (level_data.gd, level_geometry.gd, grid_nav.gd) and the level editor. Sizes are metres. on_cell: what an object sitting square on a cell does to it ('wall' = counts as a wall for nav / lighting but no solid block is built; 'open' = punches a walkable opening through a wall). blocks_nav: when placed off-centre, the monster can't path across its span. A new type needs a builder in level_geometry.gd _build_objects(); the editor draws unknown types as a plain slab.

arch.label: Arch
arch.help: A round-topped opening through a full wall. Put it square on a wall cell to punch through it

door.label: Door
door.help: A framed wood door set in its own thin wall; opens as you approach
